rating_evidence.S: Its entries describe a defensive stance using its steel body and a force field of spectral power to soften any attack, a composed, controlled temperament.

personality: Aegislash attended generations of kings, using its spectral power to guide and protect the courts it served. Its Pokédex entries say it can detect the innate qualities of leadership, and legend holds that whoever it recognizes is destined to become king. In its shield stance, Aegislash uses its steel body and a field of spectral power to soften the force of any attack.

media.title: Pokémon X and Y (games)
media.note: Wikstrom, a member of the Kalos Elite Four with a knight motif, fields Aegislash as one of his signature Pokémon.

community: Aegislash has a strong competitive reputation for its stance-switching playstyle, and its royal sword-and-shield design draws steady praise as one of the more original Steel-type concepts.

why.text: Aegislash carries the genus Royal Sword Pokémon, and its Pokédex entries describe generations of kings it attended in careful royal order.
Aegislash is said to detect the innate qualities of leadership in a person, an ability its Pokédex entries describe as a real, recognized gift.
Aegislash steadies itself with a force field of spectral power in its defensive stance, softening the force of any attack that comes.

name: Sylveon

rating_evidence.O: A Galarian fairy tale about Sylveon vanquishing a dragon is recorded in its Pokédex entries, a whimsical, imaginative bit of folklore built around it.
rating_evidence.C: Little in its entries points strongly toward either pole, so Sylveon sits near the middle of the planning scale.
rating_evidence.E: Its entries describe walking closely at its Trainer's side, wrapping a ribbon-like feeler around their arm, an affectionate, engaged habit.
rating_evidence.A: Its Pokédex entries describe sending a soothing aura from its feelers to calm fights and ease hostility, a deeply caring, peacemaking gift.
rating_evidence.S: Its entries describe restoring calm to quarrelers the instant its feelers wrap around them, an unusually steady, composed presence.

personality: Sylveon sends a soothing aura from its ribbon-like feelers that can calm a fight in progress. It wraps those same feelers around its Trainer's arm while walking, and its Pokédex entries say this touch lets Sylveon read its Trainer's feelings. A Galarian fairy tale even describes a Sylveon standing up to a dragon many times its size to protect the people around it.

media.title: Pokémon the Series: XY
media.note: Serena's Eevee evolves into Sylveon partway through her time in Kalos, one of the anime's most fondly remembered evolution moments.

community: Sylveon is a favorite among Eevee-line fans for its calming, ribbon-based design, and competitive players value its high Special Defense and access to Pixilate-boosted attacks.

why.text: Sylveon carries the genus Intertwining Pokémon, wrapping its ribbon-like feelers around its Trainer's arm as it walks beside them.
It sends a soothing aura from its ribbon-like feelers that can calm a fight already in progress, a gift named directly in its Pokédex entries.
A Galarian fairy tale describes Sylveon standing calm and steady against a dragon many times its size, protecting everyone nearby.
